prompt:
# Sori — pinceau blanc, mini-scènes v1 (direction approuvée le 19 octobre 2026)

Create ONE square vocabulary illustration, one coherent MINI-SCENE, for Sori.
Match the attached approved scene style reference: expressive warm-white brush
strokes, restrained warm-GREY washes, a few bold shapes on PURE BLACK background.
Keep the existing Sori brush aesthetic. No brown/sepia color cast, paper texture,
photorealism, 3D, vector icons, decorative framing, arrows, captions or labels.
Simplify more than the reference examples: a maximum of two or three essential
elements, broad readable silhouettes and quiet black negative space. Readable
at 96px and 112px. The useful subject must be fully inside the square, with
generous black margins. An open-ended landscape may fade into black at its edges.
NO text, letters, Hangul, numbers, signatures, logos or watermarks anywhere.
One small vermilion accent is permitted when semantically useful (autumn leaf,
fire, sunset glow). ONLY a subject explicitly asking for the Korean national
flag may also use its required true red and true blue, with exact black trigrams.
The reference is a multi-image STYLE GUIDE with labels: do NOT copy its layout,
labels or crop its examples. Generate a NEW individual square composition for
the subject below, not a sheet, comparison, grid, collage or variation pack.

These pictures are aids shown AFTER the answer, not standalone questions.
Depict the supplied meaning faithfully with necessary context; do not invent
visual distinctions between synonyms. Use the subject's requested composition,
not another existing vocabulary image. No shared or reused assets across words.
If people are needed, use clearly adult fully clothed figures and simple anatomy.
Weather/disaster scenes must be uninhabited, with no injury or suffering.


Subject:
Evening outside a small house: the sun sits low at the horizon behind the roof, long shadows and a softly illuminated window suggest the end of the day. Warm-white and grey only, no colored sunset or text. Strictly warm-white and neutral-grey brushwork on PURE BLACK; no blue, green, violet, sepia or brown cast. People are clearly adult, fully clothed, with simple natural anatomy. Keep only the essential subject, in one individual square composition with generous margins. Use the attached reference only for brush style, never its grid or labels.
note: Revue effective du WebP à 512, 160 et 96 px. Soleil bas derrière les montagnes et fenêtre allumée ; ambiance du soir lisible, accompagnée du mot pour distinguer le soir de l’aube. Style au pinceau blanc chaud/gris sur noir, sans texte ni logo ; usage aide après réponse uniquement.
